children: Tata Motors’ Jaguar Land Rover (JLR) reported a 24.5% year-on-year increase in wholesale volumes to 82,400 units in the second quarter. Retail sales, however, declined 7.5% YoY and 1.1% sequentially to 79,000 units.

The bank reported a 23.3% year-on-year increase in domestic deposits to ₹9 lakh crore in the second quarter. Gross domestic advances rose 17.7% YoY to ₹7.03 lakh crore, while total global business grew 21.07% to ₹18.92 lakh crore.

The bank reported total disbursements of ₹10,560 crore in Q2, up 33.1% year-on-year and 14.2% sequentially. Total deposits rose 29.2% YoY and 5.2% QoQ to ₹50,649 crore, while the CASA ratio stood at 90%, compared with 87.8% a year ago and 88.9% in the previous quarter.
The firm reported a 26% year-on-year increase in power sales to 5,593 million units in the second quarter, compared with 4,433 million units in the year-ago period.
The firm announced its production numbers for the second quarter ended September 30, 2026, reporting its highest-ever quarterly aluminium production of 649 KT.

title: Business Update: Vedanta Power, Ujjivan SFB, Tata Motors JLR, Bank Of India and more
